name: B10-0317/2026 (ECR) – Political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Nicaragua. It condemns the government of Daniel Ortega and Rosario Murillo for jailing opponents, indigenous leaders and religious figures. It names three people: Brooklyn Rivera, who died in custody, and Carlos Brenes and Salvadora Martínez Aburto, who were secretly given 15-year sentences. The Parliament asks Nicaragua to free all political prisoners, investigate Rivera's death, and restore rights. It also asks the European Union to sanction more people.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It concerns Nicaragua's government, its prisoners, and indigenous and religious communities.
- Next, the text is sent to Nicaragua's government and parliament; the European Union may consider more sanctions.
